references.text: Isaiah criticizes false fasting and points to what true fasting entails, providing context for Jesus' words on how to fast.
David speaks of humbling himself with fasting, reflecting the attitude behind not showing outwardly that one is fasting, as Jesus teaches.
David expresses personal humility through fasting, mirroring Jesus' call to fast without seeking attention.
Fasting is mentioned as part of the righteous man's practice, but in a context where Jesus criticizes a self-righteous attitude, offering insight into the right and wrong motives for fasting.
